questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: In frames 00:08 to 00:13, the board is fully visible and carries exactly three pens arranged in a horizontal row.
All three pens are oriented with the dark cap at the bottom and the translucent barrel at the top. The clips on the caps are all facing the same direction (right).
All three pens have black caps and translucent grey barrels. There is no color mismatch.
All pens appear to have their caps on (dark end visible). They are all of equal length and no bare writing tips are exposed.

The board moves smoothly from left to right during the main travel sequence (00:03 to 00:16). While there is a pause at the very beginning and end, this is not a mid-travel pause/jam as defined in the anomaly conditions.
The pens remain fixed in their positions relative to the board throughout the movement. No shifting or sliding is observed.

parsed.reason: The board carries three identical pens, all correctly oriented and capped. The motion is smooth and continuous from left to right without any mid-travel interruptions or anomalies.
